label: Blind sample 042: Hansen forest loss 2018, tile 20N_100W

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.12 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2018 (90% interval −0.16 to +0.28). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). But: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.04 vs typical 0.03).
reasons: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.04 vs typical 0.03)

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
